question: Operative GCC regulatory text naming HD
locator: Annex 'Medical Unfitness Cases', Infectious Diseases item 5 'Leprosy'; Art.43 action-period table (Leprosy 2 months); violations table row 4 Leprosy
finding: Regulations of Medical Examination of Expatriates Coming to GCC States for Work or Residence, 6th version 2021 (GCC Health Ministers resolution No.4, 84th meeting, 21/10/2021) lists Leprosy as a medical unfitness case without any treatment-status qualifier (contrast: TB item explicitly covers 'active or past'). GHC site states the list was last updated Oct 2023; the 2023 text was not located.
classification_change: none (HD_NAMED retained; evidence upgraded from S3/S4 FAQ to S1 regulation)

question: Original Thai-language provision
locator: Ministerial Regulation prescribing prohibited diseases for aliens entering or residing in the Kingdom B.E. 2563 (Royal Gazette vol.137 part 105 Kor pp.12-13, 25 Dec 2020), cl.3(1) and cl.4(1) 'โรคเรื้อน'
finding: Thai text names โรคเรื้อน (leprosy) without stage or treatment qualifier under Immigration Act B.E. 2522 s.12(4) (entry prohibition) and s.44(2); other listed diseases carry stage qualifiers (e.g. TB 'in dangerous stage'). Text read from a secondary consolidation (LawPlayer, S5) matching the gazette citation; the official Royal Gazette PDF returned HTTP 403.
status: partially_verified (original language yes; official-gazette copy not retrieved)

question: Current legal validity of Immigration Act Cap.14:02 s.3(1)(b)
locator: Cap.14:02 s.3(1)(b), Laws of Guyana L.R.O. 1/2012 (Ministry of Legal Affairs official revised edition)
finding: Official revised edition current to L.R.O. 1/2012 retains: prohibited immigrant includes a person 'suffering from any variety of leprosy, or from a communicable disease, as certified by a Government Medical Officer'. Amendments after 2012 not verified.

question: Current legal validity of Aliens and Nationality Law 1973 s.5.1(f)
locator: Title 4 s.5.1(f) 'afflicted with tuberculosis in any form, or with leprosy'; s.5.3(5) conditional admission excludes leprosy; family waiver petition limited to grounds (a),(d),(g),(i),(m)
finding: The only located amendment (Act of 22 July 2022) is titled and summarised (Refworld metadata; Library of Congress Global Legal Monitor 2022-10-12) as amending citizenship provisions; no evidence it amended s.5.1(f). Official gazette/consolidation not obtained; amendment text not retrieved (HTTP 403).
status: unresolved (presumed in force; not verified against official gazette)
